design.decision: Pull opponents' trumps from trick one with a strong [♠] holding, or lead [♠] to escape a bad side-suit lead.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first unbroken [♠] lead.
design.rationale: An honest freedom-to-play enabler whose value (drawing trumps early) exists in plain Spades; it is cheap enough in complexity to sit at common.
design.draftText: Your team can lead [♠] before [♠] are broken
design.hooks: A team-scoped override of the "[♠] must be broken before they are led" legality check, consulted by legal-move generation like anySuit.

history.note: draft-common: also proposed as cb-lead-spades, cc-lead-spades.

text: Your team can lead [♠] before [♠]s are broken
